admission_requirements: Admit the Organization, Project, five Artists, five Works, Curated Acquisition, Research Publications, Media References, and declared relations as one coherent publication group.
Add the content root and its reviewed machine projections to the release/manifest under the WP-1 contract without changing shared schemas or controlled vocabularies here.
Map each Work's proposal object alias, token CAIP-19, archive number, token component, metadata component, source-image component, and historical Wave manifestation to the WP-1 Work entity.
Use Work lifecycle proposed_in_museum_wave and collection membership not_in_collection.
Keep accession, title binding, custody, condition, preservation, and object-record admission as later records; do not manufacture them in this projection.
Bind the admitted release group to the exact reviewed commit and regenerated manifest.
